en.quote: [Serial production of the Zetta electric car] will begin by the end of the year. It will all depend on completion of development work.
en.head: On December 30, 2021, Manturov gave a different timeline: “the first mass-produced electric car will appear in Russia in the next year or two.”
en.body: Manturov had expected Zetta production in 2021. In March 2025, Interfax reported that Russia’s overall electric-car production plan for 2024 had been met by roughly a quarter. Those are industry-wide figures, not figures for Zetta; the fate of this specific project is not confirmed here.

notes: The outcome does not claim the industry-wide figure is evidence about Zetta.
